proof_body:
by
  intro r₁ r₂ y v hr hy hv
  have key : ∀ (r : ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ t, HasDerivAt u (r * u t) t) →
      ∀ t, u t = u 0 * Real.exp (r * t) := by
    intro r u hu t
    have hg : ∀ s, HasDerivAt (fun s => u s * Real.exp (-(r * s))) 0 s := by
      intro s
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => -(r * s)) (-(r * 1)) s :=
        ((hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul r).neg
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s => u s * Real.exp (-(r * s)))
          (r * u s * Real.exp (-(r * s)) + u s * (Real.exp (-(r * s)) * (-(r * 1)))) s :=
        (hu s).mul h1.exp
      exact h2.congr_deriv (by ring)
    have hc : u t * Real.exp (-(r * t)) = u 0 * Real.exp (-(r * 0)) :=
      is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun s => (hg s).differentiableAt) (fun s => (hg s).deriv) t 0
    have hone : Real.exp (-(r * t)) * Real.exp (r * t) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
    calc u t = u t * Real.exp (-(r * t)) * Real.exp (r * t) := by
          rw [mul_assoc, hone, mul_one]
      _ = u 0 * Real.exp (r * t) := by rw [hc]; simp
  have hd : r₁ - r₂ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hr
  refine ⟨(v 0 - r₂ * y 0) / (r₁ - r₂), -(v 0 - r₁ * y 0) / (r₁ - r₂), fun t => ?_⟩
  have hu : v t - r₂ * y t = (v 0 - r₂ * y 0) * Real.exp (r₁ * t) :=
    key r₁ (fun t => v t - r₂ * y t) (fun s => by
      have h : HasDerivAt (fun s => v s - r₂ * y s)
          ((r₁ + r₂) * v s - r₁ * r₂ * y s - r₂ * v s) s :=
        (hv s).sub ((hy s).const_mul r₂)
      exact h.congr_deriv (by ring)) t
  have hw : v t - r₁ * y t = (v 0 - r₁ * y 0) * Real.exp (r₂ * t) :=
    key r₂ (fun t => v t - r₁ * y t) (fun s => by
      have h : HasDerivAt (fun s => v s - r₁ * y s)
          ((r₁ + r₂) * v s - r₁ * r₂ * y s - r₁ * v s) s :=
        (hv s).sub ((hy s).const_mul r₁)
      exact h.congr_deriv (by ring)) t
  field_simp
  linear_combination hu - hw
target_source: ∀ (r₁ r₂ : ℝ) (y v : ℝ → ℝ), r₁ ≠ r₂ → (∀ t, HasDerivAt y (v t) t) → (∀ t, HasDerivAt v ((r₁ + r₂) * v t - r₁ * r₂ * y t) t) → ∃ c₁ c₂ : ℝ, ∀ t, y t = c₁ * Real.exp (r₁ * t) + c₂ * Real.exp (r₂ * t)
